review_mode: independent static inspection plus TypeScript check

checks.evidence: Lesson section labels, page controls, source-card controls, authority descriptions and visual-runtime controls expose VI and EN entries from one shared component tree.

LocaleBoundary updates document.documentElement.lang and adds a local lang attribute, but app/layout.tsx fixes both server html lang and RootProvider i18n locale to vi. English provider chrome therefore cannot follow the lesson locale, and the initial EN document remains vi until hydration.
LocaleLink appends window.location.hash to router.push while retaining the same lesson slug; lesson block anchors are stable registry values.

Locale switch retains the slug; LocaleBoundary dispatches only SET_LOCALE to the embedded runtime, and the reducer preserves patternId, eventIndex, inputValue and inputRevision on SET_LOCALE. Actual preservation across a Next soft navigation must be verified in-browser after the dynamic route exists.

Semantic links, buttons, fields, details/summary, skip link and focus-visible rules exist. Full tab order, focus retention after locale navigation, sidebar operation and no focus trap remain browser tests.

Each learning block is introduced by h2, while the embedded Paper4VisualRuntime creates another h2 inside the action-view block. Its panels are h3. The embedded runtime title must be exposed as a child heading of the block, or receive an embedding heading-level option.

Lesson navigation stacks at 640 px, source-card definition rows stack at 420 px, runtime panels collapse at 64 rem, forms collapse at 42 rem, and code/pre regions own overflow. A 320 px rendered overflow and target-size check is still required.
The runtime suppresses animation and transition duration under prefers-reduced-motion; the learning-page stylesheet does not add essential motion. Browser emulation remains required.

Learning-page and source-card shells use Fumadocs color tokens. The embedded runtime uses its own fixed light palette; browser contrast and readability must be checked in both themes before gate closure.

Source cards provide localized headings, native keyboard disclosure, visible focus, wrapping for long locators, authority/access-mode labels and a fixed internal conventions route. Live review of actual lesson citations is deferred until the Stage 9 registry exists.

findings.expected_fix: Add an embedding-safe heading-level/title contract so the runtime title is below the action-view h2, then inspect the rendered heading outline and accessible names.

deferred_tests: Load a VI lesson and an EN lesson directly; assert document language, provider chrome, title, TOC and ten section labels agree.
Deep-link to a middle block, switch VI to EN and back, and assert slug and hash are unchanged.
Within Action View select a non-first pattern, boundary scenario and non-zero event; switch locale and assert pattern, scenario, event index and input revision remain unchanged.
Reload both locale URLs and verify deterministic default state without hydration warnings.
Keyboard-only traversal: skip link, locale switch, TOC, source disclosure/cards, visual controls and previous/next navigation; verify visible focus and no trap.
Inspect heading outline and accessible names for one dynamic and one static action-view lesson.
At a 320 px viewport check horizontal page overflow, code-local overflow, text wrapping and touch target readability.
Check light and dark themes, including fixed-palette visual panels and source cards, for legibility and state cues independent of color.
Emulate prefers-reduced-motion and confirm autoplay/state changes remain understandable without essential animation.
Inspect actual registry-backed official, coursebook, editorial and internal source cards; confirm local locators are never href values.
